STEP 6. Check the harness wire between combination 
meter connector C-42 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112.
Q: Is the harness wire between combination meter 
connector C-42 and ETACS-ECU connector C-112 in 
good condition?
YES : Go to step 7.
NO : Repair it. The security indicator light should illuminate, 
and the theft-alarm system should be armed normally.
STEP 7. Check combination meter connector C-42 
damage.
Q: Are combination meter connector C-42 in good 
condition?
YES : Go to Step 8.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The security 
indicator light should illuminate, and the theft-alarm 
system should be armed normally.
